title: Turkish Pilaf Bread Bites
description: A crunchy and flavorful Turkish-inspired snack made with crumbly bread, crispy quick fix, and savory pilaf.
instructions: Cut the crumbly bread into 1-inch cubes and place on a baking sheet.
Drizzle the olive oil over the bread cubes and toss to coat.
Bake the bread in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
In a large skillet, heat the quick fix over medium heat.
Add the Turkish pilaf to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
Remove from heat and stir in salt to taste.
To assemble the bread bites, place a spoonful of the pilaf mixture onto a toasted bread cube.
Repeat with the remaining bread and pilaf mixture.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
